subject: C06

checks.description: Signed out, Academy's navigation offers Learn only; signed in it offers Academy's Home, Learn and Program and the web shell's Notifications and Settings. Home shows Academy's own briefing (level and XP from Academy) with no failure toast, and Program shows Academy's hub with its five sections.

No answer key or truth canary appears in any captured AX tree.

limitations: Academy is a local synthetic endpoint answering Academy's learner procedures with synthetic coursework shaped after Academy's routers at the pinned commit; hosted Academy (timing, grading, awards) is qualified in C25 (L13).
The fixture build records print sheets and browser pages instead of opening them; the native print sheet itself is not driven.
The identity practical is reached from identity-course pages the synthetic catalog does not carry; its assessor gating is covered by the route sweep and Academy's own tests, not natively.
The fixture build answers the avatar picker with an image the driver stages in its data root, and records instead of opening the print sheet; the native NSOpenPanel and print sheet are not driven.
Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names, focus and live regions are inspected.
